title: UNK_DeadDrop Companion
description: Defensive research companion for the UNK_DeadDrop artifact study. Includes a parse-only JavaScript AST scanner distributed through npm and PyPI, inert boundary fixtures, and 33 experimental YARA file-content rules in 28 files. Every YARA rule matched retained case artifacts in a read-only replay; a small local software baseline produced no hits. Authentic endpoint logs were unavailable, so Sigma event rules are not included. The available corpus does not establish production precision or recall, execution, collection, attribution, or current infrastructure status. The repository contains no live malware payloads, active credentials, victim data, private case records, or raw investigation databases.
